p: ASTREIN-AKL1. OAK sideboard. Edit the reference photograph: keep EVERYTHING exactly the same (camera, framing, sideboard shape, steel base, wall, floor, light, position, wood species, wood colour family and grain pattern of the fronts), change ONLY the surface finish of the wood. New finish: clear MATT LACQUER. The wood keeps its natural colour, slightly lighter and less saturated than oiled wood, pores closed, a smooth sealed surface with an even silky satin sheen: the warm spotlight now forms a soft, wide, diffuse highlight on the top surface and a gentle sheen across the fronts. Grain stays crisp and fully visible. Not grey, not milky, no haze, no mirror gloss.

ASTREIN-AKS1. OAK sideboard. Edit the reference photograph: keep EVERYTHING exactly the same (camera, framing, sideboard shape, steel base, wall, floor, light, position, wood species, wood colour family and grain pattern of the fronts), change ONLY the surface finish of the wood. New finish: traditional Scandinavian SOAP FINISH. The wood looks dry, pale, natural and fresh like freshly sanded raw wood with a very subtle light Nordic tone, velvety and completely matte, no shine and no reflections at all; grain stays crisp with natural contrast. Wall, floor and lighting unchanged. Not grey, not milky, no haze, no white veil over the photo.
